description:

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
The UN Security Council remains divided over the sequencing of a US-backed plan to end the war in Gaza.
The 15-point roadmap links Hamas’s disarmament to a phased Israeli military withdrawal.
Hamas accepted the plan in July, but Israel rejected it five days later, saying Hamas must disarm first.
The US has backed Israel’s interpretation that withdrawal would begin only after Hamas demonstrates full compliance.
Qatar, speaking for the Arab Group, rejected that position and said weapons control should happen in parallel with an Israeli withdrawal.
The dispute over sequencing has become a key obstacle to implementing the roadmap and ending the conflict.

Al Jazeera’s Gabriel Elizondo reports from the UN headquarters in New York.

description:
The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces have announced their dissolution and integration into the Syrian army under a deal with Damascus.
SDF commander Mazloum Abdi says the move ends the group’s status as an independent armed force.
The SDF lost significant territory to Syrian government forces in January before agreeing to integrate into state institutions.
The deal also includes guarantees for Kurdish cultural, civil and educational rights.
The move is a major step towards reunifying Syria’s armed forces and territory after years of fragmentation.
However, questions remain over heavy weapons and the future role of the SDF’s women fighters.

Al Jazeera’s Heidi Pett reports from Damascus.

Saleh Mubarak, a Syrian-American professor and writer, told Al Jazeera the SDF’s dissolution could help end a chapter of conflict and strengthen Syria’s unity.
